text_block_list.text:
On our way back from going out with Narita Taishin, we decided to take the underground sweets section at the station.
It was supposed to be a shortcut on the map, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, way too many people... Even if this is a shortcut, it's actually gonna take longer this way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's head out alr—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaah...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so, so sorry, I'm so sorry!
Are you hurt anywhere...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: N-No, not really... We just bumped into each other a bit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawa... T-Thank goodness...
I am so terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well then, um... g-goodbye...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, that smartphone on the ground by your feet.
Isn't that yours?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-Ah, you're right...!

Rice Shower hurriedly picks up her smartphone.
By chance, the words "Apple Sweets Fair" displayed on the screen caught her eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
I'm sorry, Rice is always causing trouble...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, that's not really—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"The featured item of our Apple Sweets Fair,
Whole Apple Cakes, only 10 left in stock!
If you'd like one, please hurry on over~!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whatever, but didn't you come here
to buy that thing? You're empty-handed."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's fine. I just thought it'd be nice to share a big apple cake with everyone, so I came all the way out here, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice really does just bring bad luck to everyone...
So there's no way I could invite anyone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.
No sooner had she muttered those words than Narita Taishin abruptly walked away—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I managed to buy the last one.
Not that I like sweet things, anyway. ...Here, take it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!?
T-Taixin-san... why...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. Just a whim, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Convinced that you're a hopeless failure,
not even doing what you want to do is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I just... don't like it, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Taishin-san...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's head back and make some tea!
Alright, let's gather lots of friends!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, why am I suddenly eating it too?
I already told you I hate sweet stuff."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um! Th-This cake...
It said it wasn't overly sweet...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, they say it's sweet, sour, and delicious...
...Taishin-san, would you... like to try some...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T... Together...!
That's... what Rice wants to do...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Ah, dammit.
Rice Shower returned to the academy with us, where we all enjoyed tea and cake together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Mm, go for it, Rice.
Well, you guys do whatever—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!! ...Taishin-san, would you
and your friends like to join us too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-There are still other apple sweets I want to try! I'll go buy a whole bunch, so...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please! ...I'm off!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on...!
choice_data_list: Time for a sweets festival together!
Looks like a sweets festival for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Is this really the time to be partying?! What are we gonna do about this...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
F-Friends I can invite...!?
As if I'd have any of those...!!

"...Immediately after, Winning Ticket luckily reached out,
and a crisis was averted."
